minutes.headline: Cable committee heard a space-planning pitch for its studio and saw a first FY28 draft budget showing a deficit; reorganization tabled.
minutes.summary: The Municipal Building Design Committee vice chair discussed using town hall's second floor or other space for the PAC studio and office, and the committee gave feedback on needs. The manager reviewed her activities and a preliminary FY28 budget, which is a draft to be reviewed with the town manager. Reorganization was tabled, prior minutes were approved, and the meeting adjourned.

what_happened.line: The committee saw a first draft FY28 budget that shows a deficit, because draft revenue is lower than last year while expenses are slightly under.
The manager said the draft is unconfirmed with the town accountant and will be reviewed with the town manager before it comes back for approval.
The Municipal Building Design Committee vice chair discussed using town hall's second floor or other space for the PAC studio and office, and the committee gave feedback.
Reorganization of chair and vice chair was tabled, and the vice chair stays acting chair for now.
Policy review will start in January, two policies at a time; a meeting with the attorney on studio space is set for November 23.

why_it_matters: Cable access is funded largely by Comcast payments, which are declining, so a recurring deficit puts pressure on PAC's reserves and on local meeting coverage.
Where the studio lands in the town's space plan, and what the 2028 Comcast renewal does to funding, will decide what the town spends to keep public access running.
